currency.name: Coins
currency.note: Not called 'star chips': the story already uses the Star Chip item for stars, and the outline's 'star chip' fair shops become coin shops.

tiers.note: index = opponent difficulty tier - 1 (decks' difficulty_tier, 1..10). nominal_level is the level a duelist of that tier is 'worth'.

formulas.coins_loss: 0 (a lost duel pays nothing; an ambush loss costs stolen coins)
formulas.xp: round(win_xp[tier] * clamp(1 + 0.12*(nominal_level[tier] - player_level), 0.2, 1.8)); a loss gives 25% of that (min 1); 0 at level cap

prices.meaning: A common single costs about one win of the shop's tier, B 2.5 wins, A 8 wins, S 30 wins; packs 4 / 12 / 30 wins.

drop_odds.s_rule: S cards are arena_only: in every other context their share falls to A.

rewards_story.quest_note: paid when the quest's last step completes (new effect give_coins in the quest-complete banner)
rewards_story.intro: The first coins come from Simon's test duel (stage 1 -> 2): the HUD shows 'Coins' for the first time with a one-page tutorial banner (eco_bits bit0).
rewards_story.protected_note: Cards the story hands out (give_card effects) cannot be sold.

state.append_to: Journey (mods/ow-poc/jm.h), after pt_set. Save_Read zero-fills the tail of an older file, so every new field must be valid at 0.
state.flags_note: No story flag is used (30 of 32 are taken). Everything is a counter or a bit inside Economy.
state.rotation: Shop stock rotation is derived from jm.duels, so no stock is stored.

deck_power_cap.note: Optional. FM has no deck cost.

ambush_repellent_item.note: A shop item that pauses the countdown for 5 minutes. Off by default: it weakens the difficulty the user asked for.

gang_truce_after_boss.note: Beating Old Jackal in the Underfair arena halves ambush frequency and stolen coins for good (eco_bits bit1).
